title: The Universe in One Year
lines: What if the whole history of the universe fit into one year?
The Big Bang happens on January first, at midnight.
Each day stands for about thirty-eight million years.
Our Sun doesn't ignite until early September.
The first life on Earth appears in late September.
Then, for months, almost nothing but microbes.
The dinosaurs arrive around Christmas, | and they're wiped out on December thirtieth.
Humans like us? | We show up at about eleven forty-eight p.m., on New Year's Eve.
All of recorded history fits in the last twelve seconds.
Columbus sails just over one second before midnight.
Less than a fifth of a second.
